purpose: Teach: 神浦/杉村/野坂/荒井/北野/日高/牛尾/広瀬

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、神浦刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: I see that Detective Kamiura's on-scene response is being recognized.
lines.style: Polite acknowledgment with a slight nod in the voice. Warm, collaborative tone. Even pacing. Light emphasis on the department's diligence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人杉村氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: And the police are carefully gathering statements from the witness, Mr. Sugimura.
lines.style: Continuing smoothly from the previous thought. Measured, methodical delivery. Slight upward lilt suggesting thoroughness. Supportive undertone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者野坂氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: The family of the victim, Mr. Nozaka, is being treated with proper care as well.
lines.style: Softening slightly. Genuine concern underneath the formal words. Slower pace on this line, showing weight. Warm but respectful distance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者荒井氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: And the witness statement from Mr. Arai is being carefully compiled.
lines.style: Back to procedural rhythm. Precise, attentive delivery. Light but steady. Suggesting careful documentation without fanfare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者北野の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: The suspect Kitano's prior record is being verified, I understand.
lines.style: Factual, clean delivery. Slight emphasis on completeness. Professional distance. Steady tempo, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の鑑識日高主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: And forensics chief Hidaka at the station has been working the scene verification.
lines.style: Appreciative acknowledgment. Light emphasis on the technical work. Conversational but formal. Slight warmth toward the diligent effort.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士牛尾様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: The police are also seeking counsel from psychologist Ms. Ushio on this.
lines.style: Broadening scope. Even, measured delivery. Slight lift suggesting comprehensive approach. Calm, professional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の広瀬様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And you're having pre-trial conferences with prosecutor Hirose as well.
lines.style: Warm, knowing smile in the voice. Slight intimacy — recognizing the personal coordination required. Lighter pace. Closing observation with gentle regard.
